fdroid:com.hermesagent.hermes_android.summary: Chat with your Hermes AI agent from your phone
fdroid:com.hermesagent.hermes_android.description:
Hermes Android connects your phone or tablet to your Hermes Agent over LAN, Wi-Fi, a private Tailscale network or a configured HTTPS endpoint. Use Remote Gateway JSON-RPC or REST/SSE chat with authenticated access to your own server.
Features:
• Stream text, exposed reasoning and tool groups in receipt order
• Inspect delegated-task messages, tool arguments/results and exposed reasoning in a read-only popup above the parent chat
• Refresh task history or load older rows; missing references and partial compression history carry explanations
• Choose a model and thinking effort per Remote Gateway chat
• Attach up to 10 images/files per Remote Gateway draft, capped at 64 MiB total; generic files have a 16 MiB per-file limit. REST supports one image
• Browse, search, rename, branch, delete, pin chats on this device and move chats between server Projects
• Copy/select text, read aloud, edit and resend, regenerate, stop and export
• Dictate with a compatible device speech service and use the device's text-to-speech engine for spoken replies
• Access Memory, Cron Jobs, Skills and Settings through the authenticated dashboard
• Reopen app-owned stock Gateway turns across chat navigation and reconcile pending work after reconnect or process restart without resubmitting uncertain prompts
• Review background-work, notification and battery settings, with one foreground-service disclosure and quiet per-chat ongoing status entries
• Opt in to native Google-free UnifiedPush for a selected connection and an explicit list of durable sessions
• Choose dark, light or system theme and compact chat density
Task inspection needs compatible authenticated Dashboard history routes. The API-server key alone cannot read that richer history. A gateway may omit compression segments; the viewer does not claim complete history or control child runtimes. Exposed reasoning means text the server supplies for display.
UnifiedPush is off by default and uses no Firebase/FCM SDK. Install a compatible distributor on Android and ask the operator to install and enable the separate mobile-push server companion, configure VAPID and grant your dashboard login the exact session scopes. Registration requires explicit consent and encrypted challenge confirmation. Push hints omit chat text; authenticated notification taps open the session and cannot approve actions or resubmit prompts.
Background operation and push are best-effort. Force stop, Doze, OEM battery controls, offline devices, permissions and distributor availability can prevent or delay delivery. A foreground service does not guarantee uninterrupted networking. Stock history reconciliation is separate from the experimental exactly-once recovery contract, which needs gateway support.
Requires a running Hermes Agent server reachable from the device. Hermes Android does not install or configure that server, a distributor or an external account.

fdroid:com.seeker.seekprivacy.name: SeekPrivacy

fdroid:com.seeker.seekprivacy.description:
Standard vaults create a clunky "island." SeekPrivacy creates a shield. Apps like social media and basic tools demand "Storage Access"if you refuse, they break. If you accept, they spy . This creates a painful trade-off between functionality and privacy .
 SeekPrivacy is built on the principle that your phone's operating system and other apps should be considered "hostile territory." It assumes the Android OS is compromised and every other app is a potential spy . Its architecture ensures that even if a malicious app gains full control of the device, your data remains a cryptographic black box.
 SeekPrivacy eliminates this blackmail. It provides multi-layered defense by isolating data within an encrypted sandbox, inaccessible to other apps , the OS , or unauthorized physical extraction —providing activist-grade security . Built on the belief "Privacy Without the Tradeoff of Ease" , even if a malicious app has full device control, it sees nothing .

fdroid:es.ideotec.workouttime.name: Workout Time!
fdroid:es.ideotec.workouttime.summary: An app for managing and performing timed workouts
fdroid:es.ideotec.workouttime.description:
Home Screen 
Lists all workouts (the app comes with two predefined workouts, and others can be created or imported). Tapping on the pencil icon on the left of a workout will go to the Edit Screen, tapping on the title or duration of a workout will start it from the beginning, tapping on the "⌄" symbol on the right will show a list of the exercises it contains. Each exercise has a preparation/rest time before it (shown on the left), and a duration (shown on the right). Tapping on an exercise in the list will start the workout at that exercise. To add a new workout, tap on the "+" button on the bottom right corner and select "Create" to build it from scratch or "Import" to load a workout in JSON format. At the top-right corner of the home screen are two icons: a calendar with a checkmark in it (tapping this will go to the Log Screen) and a gear (tapping this will go to the Settings Screen).
 Workout Screen 
When a workout is running there is a progress bar at the top showing the current point in the workout, with the time elapsed on the left and the time remaining (indicated with a "-") on the right. In between these two times are a series of dots that represent the exercises in the workout, with the current exercise highlighted in blue. Below this is the name of the current exercise. During the exercise preparation time the name will have "Get ready for" before it (tapping on this will skip the preparation and begin the exercise). Below the exercise name is a stopwatch showing the current progress in that exercise, with the remaining time in the middle. Tapping on the stopwatch will pause the workout (indicated by blinking time inside the stopwatch), and tapping again will resume it. At the bottom of the screen is the name of the next exercise. Tapping on this will skip to the next exercise.
 Edit screen 
Lists all exercises in a workout, with the preparation time on the left and the duration on the right. To change an exercise, tap on it and the two times will become spinners that can be swiped up or down to modify the time. Long-pressing on the spinner allows modifying the number with the keyboard (must be a number of seconds without any punctuation). Tapping on the exercise name will bring up the keyboard to edit it. Under the name are three icons: an up arrow to move the exercise higher in the list, a down arrow to move it lower, and a trash can to delete the it. In the top-right corner of the screen are two icons: a download icon to save the workout in JSON format to the Downloads folder, and a trash can to delete the entire workout.
 Log Screen 
Lists all the executions of workouts, with the date and time on the left and the name of the workout on the right. At the top-right corner of the screen is a download icon that will save this list in JSON format to the Downloads folder.
 Settings Screen 
This screen has three dropdown menus to select the sound to play for the last 3 seconds of preparation/exercise time, at the start and end of each exercise, and at the end of the workout. There are 4 options for each: nothing, a beep, a ding, or an applause.

fdroid:io.github.gurov.brevier.name: Brevier
fdroid:io.github.gurov.brevier.summary: A reading browser: the web without JavaScript, set in your own type
fdroid:io.github.gurov.brevier.description:
Brevier opens a web page, reduces it to its text and structure — headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code, tables, images — and sets it in the reader's typography: a comfortable line length and leading, warm paper in light or dark, four ready-made styles or your own face, size and spacing. No JavaScript runs and no site styles apply. The type is the reader's, not the site's.
What it does
• Articles, blogs, documentation and long reads come out as clean text. The page's own contents, the feeds it offers and its navigation sit on a shelf at the side.
• Long reads remember where you stopped and offer to continue from there.
• Notes on a page: highlight a passage or write a few words beside it, with pictures of your own if you like; they stand under their paragraph and go out as Markdown. The marks come back when you open the page again, even after the site has changed around them.
• Every article you read is kept on the phone as your copy: it opens after the site has changed or gone, and "Search what you've read" looks through all of them.
• Search from the address bar: words that are not an address go to DuckDuckGo Lite, and the results come back as a list of links.
• RSS, Atom and JSON feeds, including feed files and feed:// links. A feed of comments on one page reads as a thread, and so do Hacker News, Lobsters, Discourse forums and Mastodon posts. Habr articles come with their comments.
• Documentation straight from GitHub and GitLab repositories: type gh:owner/repo.
• Tabs, history, bookmarks, find on page, zoom, saving an article as Markdown (with its images, as a zip).
• Pages read in the last week open without downloading.
• Back and forward return to the place you were reading.
• It can be your default browser: links from other apps open in new tabs, and what needs JavaScript or a login goes on to your other browser in one tap.
• Check this page: a score from 0 to 100 for how well a page reads without JavaScript, with the reasons.
What it does not do
• Run JavaScript, apply site styles, keep cookies or log in.
• Show ads, count its users or ask for an account. Brevier reports nothing to anyone: it fetches the pages you open and what it takes to read them, and your searches go to DuckDuckGo.
Sites assembled entirely by JavaScript do not open. Brevier says so plainly and offers your other browser.
Images are decoded by Brevier's own memory-safe decoders, not the system's. Certificates are checked by Android, and a site Android does not trust does not open.
Brevier is free software, under MIT or Apache-2.0. The same core runs a GTK window on Linux and Windows.

fdroid:io.github.jcastell7.modernt9.name: Modern T9
fdroid:io.github.jcastell7.modernt9.summary: Predictive T9 keyboard with no network access and no telemetry
fdroid:io.github.jcastell7.modernt9.description:
Nine-key predictive text for current Android, and nothing else. Modern T9 declares no permissions at all — without the INTERNET permission the system would refuse a network connection even if the keyboard attempted one.
A keyboard is the most privileged app on a phone: it sees every password, every message, every search. Modern T9 is built so that privilege costs you nothing.
Privacy by construction
- No INTERNET permission and no networking code of any kind.
- No analytics, ads, telemetry or crash reporting.
- Learned words and saved phrases stay in app-private storage, as plain text files you can read yourself.
- Clipboard history is held in memory only and is never written to disk.
- Android's backup carries your settings and deliberately leaves your dictionary behind.
Typing
- Real T9 prediction over English (US) and Spanish (Latin America) dictionaries — one language at a time, or both at once.
- ABC multi-tap when you would rather spell a word out letter by letter.
- A strip down the left side for saying which letter a key meant, accented forms and ñ included.
- Saved phrases for email addresses, URLs and handles: tap the first few keys of the code and the whole thing is offered.
- It learns the words you actually use, so they move to the front over time.
- Long-press a key for accents and symbols; flick a key downward for its digit.
- Closing punctuation attaches to the word you just finished instead of drifting off after a space.
- Tap into a word to reopen it and choose a different spelling in place.
- An editing pane with cursor keys, selection, copy, cut, paste and undo. A clipboard history. An emoji picker.
- Adjustable keyboard height and clearance above the navigation bar.
The prediction engine sits behind a small interface and is a replaceable module, so a different backend can be dropped in without touching the keyboard itself.
Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. The dictionaries are built from the OpenSubtitles 2018 word frequency lists published by HermitDave/FrequencyWords, used under CC BY-SA 4.0.

classic: 4x4

bigger: 6x6

firefox-addons:5791.name: Flagfox
firefox-addons:5791.summary: Displays a country flag depicting the location of the current website's server and provides a multitude of tools such as site safety checks, whois, translation, validation, URL shortening, and more...
firefox-addons:5791.description:
Flagfox is an extension that displays a flag icon indicating the current webserver's physical location. Knowing where you're connected to adds an extra layer of awareness to your browsing and can be useful to indicate the native languages and legal jurisdictions that may apply. Additional information can be obtained via a multitude of external lookups and users can add their own custom actions. All actions can be added to the flag icon's context menu and set to icon click or keyboard shortcuts for quick access.
Clicking the flag icon loads our default action, Geotool , which gives a detailed map showing the city the server is in and other useful information such as its local time and ISP . Many other actions are available for a wide range of uses such as:
 Site safety and malware checks
 Finding similar sites and reviews
 Automatic translation to your language
 SEO and web development research
 Diagnostics like pings and traceroutes
 Whois and DNS information
 Page code validation
 Quick URL shortening
 Copying a server's IP address or other info
 or you can create your own custom actions!
Flagfox is simple, unobtrusive, and uses relatively little resources. In order to protect your privacy, country lookups are done locally rather than asking an external server about every page you browse to. It works by accessing an internal IP address location database, basically a rough map of the physical layout of the Internet, based on data provided by Maxmind . This gives a flag for the nationality of the actual location of the server you're connected to, rather than just the nationality of the domain name which may be different. Flagfox updates are provided on a monthly basis to keep this internal database accurate.

firefox-addons:3043536.name: YouTube Subtitle Word Translator
firefox-addons:3043536.summary: Click any word in YouTube subtitles to instantly translate it. Supports Google, DeepL, LibreTranslate with offline caching.
firefox-addons:3043536.description:
YouTube Subtitle Word Translator makes language learning effortless while watching videos. Simply click any word in YouTube subtitles to see its translation instantly in a tooltip.
 Key Features: 
• Click-to-translate: Click any subtitle word → instant translation tooltip
• Multiple providers: Google Translate (free), DeepL Free/Pro, LibreTranslate, custom endpoints
• 30 UI languages: English, Russian, Belarusian, German, French, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and more — each displayed in its native script
• Smart CJK support: Chinese/Japanese/Korean text split per-character for precise translation
• Dark mode: Automatic (system) or manual light/dark/theme switching
• Works on: YouTube, YouTube Music, YouTube TV
• Offline caching: LRU cache (500 entries) for instant repeat translations
• Secure: API keys stored locally, optional host permissions for self-hosted endpoints
• No tracking: Zero analytics, zero external requests except translation APIs
 Supported Providers: 
| Provider | API Key | Notes |
|----------|---------|-------|
| Google Translate | Not required | Free, good quality |
| DeepL Free | Required | High quality, generous free tier |
| DeepL Pro | Required | Best quality, higher limits |
| LibreTranslate | Optional | Self-hostable, privacy-focused |
| Custom endpoint | Optional | Your own LibreTranslate-compatible server |
 Privacy First: 
• No data collection, no analytics, no tracking
• All settings and cache stored locally in your browser
• API keys never leave your device except to the chosen provider
• Host permission requested only when you configure a custom endpoint
 Permissions: 
• storage — save settings and translation cache
• host_permissions — YouTube, Google Translate, DeepL, LibreTranslate domains
• optional_permissions — custom endpoint domain (requested on-demand)
Open source (MIT): https://github.com/pvarenik/youtube-subtitle-translator

firefox-addons:3034305.name: Video Downloader Plus
firefox-addons:3034305.summary: Download videos from Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Vimeo, and many other sites. Play the video first, then save it in the quality you choose. Includes screen recording for hard-to-capture streams. YouTube is not supported.
firefox-addons:3034305.description:
Video Downloader Plus helps you save videos from a wide range of websites directly in Firefox. When a video is playing on the page, the extension detects available streams and shows them in a simple popup so you can download the file you want.
 How it works 
1. Open a page with a video and start playback .
2. Click the Video Downloader Plus toolbar icon.
3. Choose a detected stream and download it, or use Record when direct download is not available.
 Features 
- Detects video streams automatically while you watch
- Shows useful details such as resolution, file size, duration, and format
- Direct download when the site exposes a downloadable stream
- Screen recording for live or protected content
- Works across many popular platforms
 Supported sites include 
Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, Vimeo, Twitter/X, and many other video sites.
 Important notes 
- YouTube is not supported. 
- The video usually must be playing on the page before streams appear.
- On some sites, open the full video page (for example, a single TikTok or Instagram post) for best results.
- Some content may be protected and cannot be downloaded.
- Only download videos you have the right to save.
 Privacy 
Video Downloader Plus works locally in your browser to detect streams on pages you visit. Use it responsibly and respect website terms and copyright laws.

firefox-addons:492002.name: Multiple File Downloader
firefox-addons:492002.summary: Downloads multiple files from any page
firefox-addons:492002.description:
Hassle-free download of multiple files. Lets you choose from all downloadable content on a page.
MSI Multiple-file downloader uses the new HTML5 "download" attribute to decide if a file is downloadable. If anything on the page is downloadable, you see the download icon in your address bar. Click on the icon, choose the files you want and Firefox does the rest.
MSI Multiple-file downloader works with non-HTML5 pages, too. As a website developer, you can put the "download" attribute into any anchor tags to instantly add multiple-file download capability to your web page.
*** Changes

* 1.1.0 remove individual download links from popup UI

- destination directory now created if it doesn't exist
- files with names that already exist on disk are renamed when saved

firefox-addons:3063446.name: Zapkit: WhatsApp Web toolkit
firefox-addons:3063446.summary: Zapkit adds 15+ tools to WhatsApp Web. Transcribe voice messages in one click, translate chats both ways, rewrite before you send, blur your screen when someone walks up, lock with a PIN, set reminders. No API key. Nothing is read in the background.
firefox-addons:3063446.description:
Zapkit is the toolkit WhatsApp Web never had.
It lives inside the page you already use. There is no other app to open, no number to change, no API key to paste, and nothing happens until you click.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
AI, with no key to set up
• TRANSCRIBE a voice message in one click. An eight minute audio becomes text you read in twenty seconds, right in the chat.
• SEARCH inside what was said. Everything you transcribed becomes searchable, so you can find which voice message mentioned that address or that price.
• TRANSLATE incoming and outgoing messages. Both ways, so you can serve someone in a language you do not speak.
• REWRITE what you are about to send: fix spelling, make it clearer, more direct, more formal, friendlier, or give it a business tone. Seven presets, and the text lands in the box for you to review. Nothing is sent automatically.
• SUMMARIZE a long conversation or a long voice message, and get what was decided and what is still open.
The AI runs on Zapkit's servers. You do not create an account, paste a key or pick a model.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Privacy, on your screen and on your account
• PRIVACY MODE blurs what is on display and reveals only what your mouse is on. Eleven separate controls: contact names, photos, recent messages, the open conversation, the message box, and more. Useful in an office, a cafe, or a screen share.
• PIN LOCK hides your chats behind a code. It can lock on its own after idle time, sound an alarm on wrong attempts and refuse new tries for a while. The PIN is stored as a salted hash on your machine and never transmitted.
• READ WITHOUT A RECEIPT, view a status without notifying, play a voice message without the sender knowing, and hide your typing and recording indicators.
• RESTORE messages that were deleted for everyone, from what had already reached your screen.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
The everyday work
• REMINDERS that fire at the time you set, optionally tied to a conversation. They warn by system notification and on screen, and survive the browser restarting.
• QUICK REPLIES behind a slash shortcut. Type /quote and space, and the canned answer lands ready to edit.
• NOTES about a contact, attached to the chat, visible only to you and never sent. Searchable across every contact.
• WAITING FOR A REPLY: the list of chats where the last message is theirs and you have not answered, built on its own from who spoke last.
• KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS for the main actions, including locking the session instantly.
• A HEADS-UP when someone starts typing in a conversation that is not on your screen.
• Pin beyond the native limit, mark as read or unread from the header, start a chat with a number that is not in your contacts, and download a status.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Made to feel like yours
Interface in English, Portuguese and Spanish. Five base themes plus twelve color palettes, eighteen icon styles, and every feature has its own on and off switch. Turn on only what you use.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
What leaves your machine, and what does not
Zapkit reads nothing in the background. A message goes to our servers only when you click transcribe, translate, rewrite or summarize, and it is discarded once the answer comes back. Your quick replies, your reminders, your PIN and the transcripts you asked for stay in your browser. Contact notes are kept in your account so they survive a change of computer, with the contact identified by an irreversible hash, never by the number.
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Free and Pro
Free is a real plan, not a trial: everything above, with quotas of 3 active reminders, 3 quick replies and the core AI presets. Pro removes the limits and unlocks the rest, monthly or yearly.
Zapkit is an independent product. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to WhatsApp or Meta. WhatsApp is a trademark of its respective owner.

firefox-addons:989173.name: Instant Password Generator
firefox-addons:989173.summary: Instantly generate strong passwords in the add-on's popup or fill in password input fields with random password by double clicking the chosen field!
firefox-addons:989173.description:
With this extension, you can instantly fill in any password input field with a strong password on every page you browse by double clicking the chosen input. Moreover, you can generate random passwords in the extension's popup window, where you can also modify various password settings (e.g. whether it should contain lowercase letters or be auto-copied to your clipboard).
Features:
- quickly generate strong, random passwords
- change password's complexity and choose its length or set it as random
- double click any password input on page to automatically fill it in along with other password fields, so that you don't need to confirm it!
- option to automatically copy generated passwords to your clipboard
- enable the password auto-copy option to make it even faster
- settings are synchronized with your Firefox account
- the extension is safe to use as it does not store any passwords either online or locally, except for copying it to your clipboard (optional)
The source code of this extension project is available at my GitLab repo:
 https://gitlab.com/undefined.dev/passwordGeneratorExtension

firefox-addons:2931926.description:
To set up your website URL to open in a new tab whenever you create one, you need to enter the URL address in the add-on options. Once you've done that, simply press the "+" button to create a new tab (or use the Ctrl+T shortcut) and your website will open automatically.
